purpose: Pre-specified clinical-priority weights for the DODA post-selection ranking layer.
important_note: These numerical weights are an investigator-defined operationalization of clinical evidence. They are not weights published by KDIGO, WHO, or any cited paper.

normalization.interpretation: Higher value = greater clinical priority in the DODA ranking layer.

methodological_rule: Weights are assigned from clinical relevance and evidence hierarchy, not from the observed association with Class in this dataset. Dataset-derived statistics must not be used to set these weights.
